comparison.objective: Choose fitting tweezers and peel protective film while stabilizing a display carrier; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool selection, passive-tweezer actuation, tab pinching, controlled peeling, counterholding, and tool return versus hex-key engagement and collar commissioning.
comparison.success_condition: Complete peel without excess carrier motion, film supported outside, tools correctly returned, and hands clear versus two acceptable impact cycles and retained setting.
comparison.reason: Both demand bimanual stabilization and small-tool use, but the physical transformations and verification differ; no material rubric details are missing.
